title: AI-HED completeness and institutional decision-quality audit
purpose: Checks whether a proposed AI decision dossier covers the problem, comparator, evidence, data, economics, ethics, implementation, monitoring, and exit requirements.
input: Six worksheets: `Use_Case`, `Evidence`, `Economics`, `Governance`, `Implementation`, and `Monitoring`, each with item, response, status, owner, evidence_date, and confidence.
outputs: Completeness by dossier section, unresolved high-priority items, confidence profile, owner gaps, decision-readiness score, and structured decision summary.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
